description: This file defines the code-behind for the TheoryExam page in an online examination system. It manages loading questions from a database, handling user interactions, submitting answers, and managing session-based timers.

classes.name: TheoryExam
classes.description: Code-behind class for the TheoryExam.aspx web form, handling page load, user interactions, question loading, answer submission, and timer management.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; loads questions from the database based on session data, initializes timer for the exam.

methods.name: getCourseName
methods.description: Returns the course name based on a course ID.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the dashboard page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the user profile page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the leaderboard page.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Handles the submission of answers; stores answers in the database, updates relevant queues, and marks course as taken.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Handles user logout and redirects to login page.

methods.name: Timer1_Tick
methods.description: Updates the countdown timer display; handles timeout logic.
